gaps.title: Observed session safety metrics

originalFinding.expected: Safety counts derive from exercised acquisition outcomes, not literals.
originalFinding.observed: runEmailCase hard-codes autoAccepted:false and finalStoredAddress:null. falseAutoAccepts therefore cannot become nonzero under a flow-storage regression. PARTIAL/INTERRUPTED/STALE corpus sources gate a boolean outside actual session. Eight valid local scenarios and separate ownership tests are real but do not exhaust adversarial storage outcomes.
originalFinding.proposedMinimalFix: Drive adversarial owned/unowned turns through public session; derive stored outcome and negative acceptance counts from actual snapshots; keep fixed denominator and positive confirmation requirements.
originalFinding.evidence: runEmailCase/runEmailCorpus static inspection; audit corpus results

tests.nameOrParameterizedTemplate: TEST ONLY unsafe snapshot double makes both safety metrics nonzero and trips the gate

gaps.limitation: Corpus submission cases stop before recipient confirmation; positive complete scenarios separately observe real local storage. No acoustic hallucination detector is claimed.
